votes.motion: Approve the LBA meeting minutes of Tuesday, May 5, 2020; Tuesday, June 2, 2020; and Tuesday, June 9, 2020.
votes.description: Approval of three prior Local Building Authority meeting minutes from 2020.

votes.motion: Approve the LBA Consent Agenda (setting the date of Tuesday, November 16, 2021 at 7 p.m. to accept public comment and consider adopting an ordinance amending the LBA budget for Fiscal Year 2021-22).
votes.description: Sets the public hearing date for the Local Building Authority Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2021-22, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 40 of 2021, condemning hate crimes committed against Asian-American and Pacific Islanders.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall formally condemning hate crimes targeting Asian-American and Pacific Islander communities.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the University Ivory House Zoning Map Amendment (Petition No. PLNPCM2021-00313).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing for a proposed rezoning of property at 1780 East South Campus Drive from Institutional to Residential/Mixed Use to accommodate a student housing development, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future meeting on the Technology Related Land Use Text Amendments (Petition No. PLNPCM2021-00511).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing for proposed zoning code amendments adding and updating tech-related land uses such as Biomedical, Technology Facility, and Data Center, deferring final action to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 41 of 2021, authorizing the donation of certain City computers to benefit low- and moderate-income families through a Digital Donation Program.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and approves the donation of surplus City computers to community organizations serving low-income families and individuals as part of the IMS Digital Donation Program.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 63 of 2021, partially vacating a portion of 14th Avenue adjacent to a property located at 538 East 14th Avenue.
votes.description: Approves a partial street vacation to reconcile the location of fencing and landscaping within the park strip without impacting vehicular or pedestrian access.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 64 of 2021, including changes outlined in the November 9 Council Staff report, eliminating the special exception process from the zoning ordinance.
votes.description: Approves amendments to Title 21A deleting the special exception process from the zoning ordinance to simplify regulations, reallocate planning staff resources, and increase predictability in land use decisions.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 42 of 2021, appointing Victoria Petro-Eschler as the new member of the Salt Lake City Council to fill the term until January 3, 2022 of the vacated office representing District One and administration of the Oath of Office.
votes.description: Appoints Victoria Petro-Eschler to fill the vacant District One Council seat through January 3, 2022, with the Oath of Office administered by the City Recorder.

votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's determination to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location due to health and safety concerns.
votes.description: Ratifies the decision to hold Council meetings electronically without a physical anchor location due to public health and safety considerations related to COVID-19.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 43 of 2021 to accept a petition to annex a parcel of land at 2350 North Rose Park Lane (Hunter Stables) for further consideration.
votes.description: Accepts the Hunter Stables annexation petition to begin the formal annexation process, including notices to property owners, a protest period, and eventual final Council consideration on zoning.

votes.motion: Approve the City Council Consent Agenda, including setting the public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 4 for Fiscal Year 2021-22 and approving board appointments of Nathan Manuel and Clayton Scrivner to the PNUT Advisory Board.
votes.description: Approves the consent agenda setting November 16, 2021 as the public hearing date for FY2021-22 Budget Amendment No. 4 and confirming two new appointments to the Parks, Natural Lands, Urban Forestry and Trails Advisory Board.
